jobs.name: Wayfarer Concourse — shared tower lobby
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one complete playable-map CONCEPT IMAGE for owner review; not a texture atlas, sprite sheet, finished game implementation, website or marketing poster.
Input references: Image 1 is the current Neon Heights native map; use its fine textured pixel rendering, restrained contours, readable scale and characteristic building shapes as art vocabulary. Image 2 is approved Care Grove pixel rendering/camera only, never its medieval content or daylight palette.
Style: detailed hand-authored-looking textured 2D RPG pixel art, elevated top-down three-quarter orthographic game camera with visible building fronts and tops; not diamond-isometric, not cinematic low-angle, not photorealistic. Fine precise pixel clusters, material shading, colored deep recesses, modest outlines. Continuous ground, no editor square grid, no obvious repeating tile squares. Buildings are independent grounded masses around a readable navigable route.
Composition: landscape full-map view, coherent connected paths with generous native actor walking clearance. Render the concept as an opaque finished scene image, with no UI overlay, HUD, logos, text labels, arrows, stats, legible advertisements, border or watermark. No giant character portrait. A few tiny non-detailed NPC/player silhouettes may establish scale where specified, without implying finalized character designs. Keep actor paths brighter/quieter than dense scenery and do not cover destinations with roofs.
Motion is a future implementation requirement: design separable local light strips, holographic elements and machinery that could animate while structures remain fixed. Do not depict motion blur or excessive full-scene bloom.
Primary request: envision the SHARED TOWER LOBBY for a 50-floor RPG, a safe readable transit-and-preparation concourse used between differently themed floors. This lobby is not a copy of the cyberpunk street.
Setting: a roof-cutaway tower foyer in graphite-blue stone and aged metal with warm amber lamps, restrained ivory floor inlays, wood/leather seating and small teal control lights. Calm neutral infrastructure that can connect to many future worlds. Detailed and lived-in rather than glossy spaceship.
Layout: one substantial central lift gate on the upper/north wall, its vertical mechanism framed by architectural columns. A broad unobstructed central preparation plaza connects to that gate and the lower/south arrival threshold. On the left flank a compact trading counter and tidy supply crates; lower-left an inviting free rest/camp alcove with two benches, rolled packs and a small warm lamp. On the right flank a clearly distinct expedition/quest board and planning desk with small icon-like map displays. Open side aisles connect every facility without walking through counters. Decorative plant pots and narrow floor conduits stay on the perimeter. A single small geometric paw relief may be part of the lift architecture without text or a brand logo. Tiny standing traveler silhouettes establish door and bench scale. No battle, enemies, additional city district, 50 separate doors, elevated inaccessible walkways or glowing cosmic globe.
Framing: show the entire foyer, all destinations and their routes in one cohesive map-like composition. Warm restrained amber, slate/navy, muted teal. This is concept A, not an exported asset pack.

Primary request: envision an improved ARRIVAL DISTRICT derived closely from reference Image 1's actual Neon Heights layout and its cyan/magenta architecture. Preserve the identity of the existing map while giving it a useful camp and clear destinations.
Layout: dense imposing cyan-glass and magenta-ring towers frame the top/north perimeter; smaller habitat blocks frame middle left and right. Two connected horizontal wet boulevards cross a broad central spine. A central plaza contains one beautiful cyan android head-and-shoulders projection on a clearly grounded emitter, plus two small cyan/pink koi emitters. Keep projections translucent but legible, no huge opaque haze.
Lower/south zone: a safe observation/maintenance terrace framed by thin steel rails and rooftop ventilation units. Put a visible return lift entrance centered on the lower edge, opening onto a wide walkable central lane. Lower-left place Mara's modest warm-lit medical/camp canopy with a real-sized seat, a few wrapped supply crates and a rest beacon; lower-right put a small route-planning board and a utility station, away from the central walk. An east/right street exit naturally points toward the market; the west edge is closed by scenery/railings. Keep all camp/plaza/main-road connections clear. The terrace is the SAME ground plane, not an implied jumping puzzle. Two tiny neutral silhouettes near the camp and hologram suggest NPC scale without large faces.
Mood: inhabited safe night district, cool cyan, indigo and magenta reflections on graphite; small warm shelter accent. Fine textured pixel detail rather than chunky cartoon. Add tasteful street-edge detail and asymmetry; preserve continuous reflective roads without grid lines. Frame the whole playable district, readable from above.

Primary request: envision the LUMEN MARKET, the next connected cyberpunk stage beyond Neon Heights arrival. A compact lived-in maintenance bazaar where a merchant, repair/crafting bay and an important power-allocation board occupy distinct pockets around a clear main route.
Layout: west/left arrival passage opens into a broad gently bending central market street that connects to a marked architectural utility hatch/gate on the upper/north edge. Four to six small charcoal kiosks and cloth/metal awnings line the sides, with cyan display panels and magenta trim. The lower-left/west repair bay has a lifted canopy, workbench, dry shelves and coiled cable, with a usable interaction approach in front. On the right/east Ivo's salvage counter is distinct: spare parts, secure emergency-cell case, glass canopy and small warm work light. Near the northern utility gate a distinct three-channel power allocation cabinet shows three separable icon displays and thick insulated cables, without letters/numbers or text. Keep its walkable approach clear and make it visibly different from the vendor.
A small lower/south side alcove contains a broken unlit advertisement panel and a discoverable maintenance cache. Leave the return route obvious; don't trap the player in a dense wall of stalls. Distant upper-edge habitat facades echo the existing Neon Heights architecture, lower and denser than its skyscrapers. Ground is continuous wet graphite pavement with authored puddle/reflection patches, no editor grid or repeated square texture seams. Tiny silhouettes at counter/repair area establish scale. No monsters or combat, no crowds that hide paths.
Mood: practical, slightly weathered, safe cyberpunk market at night; cyan/magenta light pockets, muted rust and copper, small amber lamps. Precise textured RPG pixel rendering matching the references, no photoreal lens bloom or sci-fi hologram UI screen filling the scene.
